thesis: This episode argues that the FAAMG tech giants (Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Apple, Facebook) collectively represent about 23% of the S&P 500, suggesting a significant concentration in the market. It further posits that Bitcoin should be treated as a legitimate asset class for allocator portfolios, while Ethereum is viewed as the 'oil' of the crypto world expected to outperform Bitcoin. Additionally, the discussion highlights the potential of Messenger RNA technologies in longevity and virus defense.
